mapper.select: select e.organization_id as organizationId, e.stat_date as statDate, e.owner_user_id as ownerUserId, max(e.owner_user_name) as ownerUserName, max(e.owner_dept_id) as ownerDeptId, max(e.owner_dept_name) as ownerDeptName, count(distinct case when e.metric_type = 'INBOUND' then e.customer_id end) as inboundCustomerCount, count(distinct case when e.metric_type = 'CONTACT' then e.customer_id end) as contactedCustomerCount, 0 as dialCount, 0 as connectedCount, 0 as callDurationSec, 0 as callOver1minCount, 0 as callOver3minCount, count(distinct case when e.metric_type = 'WECHAT_FRIEND' and ifnull(e.valid_flag, 1) = 1 then e.customer_id end) as newWechatFriendCount, count(distinct case when e.metric_type = 'VISIT_CUSTOMER' and ifnull(e.valid_flag, 1) = 1 then e.customer_id end) as visitCustomerCount from report_employee_stat_event e where e.stat_date = #{statDate} and e.organization_id is not null and e.organization_id != '' and e.owner_user_id is not null and e.owner_user_id != '' group by e.organization_id, e.stat_date, e.owner_user_id

select date_format(from_unixtime(cra.begin_timestamp / 1000), '%Y-%m-%d') as statDate, cra.customer_id as customerId, cra.biz_ext_info as bizExtInfo, 1 as dialCount, case when ifnull(cra.is_connected, 0) = 1 then 1 else 0 end as connectedCount, case when ifnull(cra.is_connected, 0) = 1 then ifnull(cra.duration, 0) else 0 end as callDurationSec, case when ifnull(cra.is_connected, 0) = 1 and ifnull(cra.duration, 0) >= 60 then 1 else 0 end as callOver1minCount, case when ifnull(cra.is_connected, 0) = 1 and ifnull(cra.duration, 0) >= 180 then 1 else 0 end as callOver3minCount, 0 as visitCustomerFlag from mmba_call_record_audit cra where cra.begin_timestamp between #{startTime} and #{endTime} and cra.direction = 0 and ifnull(cra.call_type, 0) = 1 and cra.customer_id is not null and cra.customer_id != ''

select date_format(from_unixtime(cra.begin_timestamp / 1000), '%Y-%m-%d') as statDate, cra.customer_id as customerId, cra.biz_ext_info as bizExtInfo, 0 as inboundCustomerFlag, 0 as contactedCustomerFlag, 0 as newWechatFriendFlag, 0 as visitCustomerFlag, 1 as dialCount, case when ifnull(cra.is_connected, 0) = 1 then 1 else 0 end as connectedCount, case when ifnull(cra.is_connected, 0) = 1 and ifnull(cra.duration, 0) >= 60 then 1 else 0 end as callOver1minCount, case when ifnull(cra.is_connected, 0) = 1 and ifnull(cra.duration, 0) >= 180 then 1 else 0 end as callOver3minCount, case when ifnull(cra.is_connected, 0) = 1 then ifnull(cra.duration, 0) else 0 end as callDurationSec from mmba_call_record_audit cra where cra.begin_timestamp between #{startTime} and #{endTime} and cra.direction = 0 and ifnull(cra.call_type, 0) = 1 and cra.customer_id is not null and cra.customer_id != ''

select sou.user_id as operatorUserId, su.name as employeeName, sou.department_id as departmentId, sd.name as departmentName from sys_organization_user sou join sys_user su on su.id = sou.user_id left join sys_department sd on sd.id = sou.department_id where sou.organization_id = #{orgId} and ifnull(sou.enable, true) = true order by ifnull(sd.pos, 0) asc, su.name asc

select c.id as customerId, cf.field_value as customerSource from customer c left join customer_field cf on cf.resource_id = c.id and cf.field_id = ( select mf.id from sys_module_field mf join sys_module_form form on mf.form_id = form.id where form.organization_id = #{orgId} and form.form_key = 'customer' and mf.internal_key = 'customerSource' limit 1 ) where c.organization_id = #{orgId} and c.id in
#{customerId}

select id, customer_id as customerId, event_time as eventTime from report_employee_stat_event where metric_type = 'VISIT_CUSTOMER' and valid_flag = 0 and organization_id = #{orgId} and customer_id = #{customerId} order by event_time desc, create_time desc limit 2
mapper.update: update report_employee_stat_event set valid_flag = 1, event_time = #{eventTime}, stat_date = #{statDate}, biz_trace_id = #{esId} where id = #{id} and valid_flag = 0

update report_employee_stat_event set valid_flag = 1, event_type = #{eventType}, event_time = #{eventTime}, stat_date = #{statDate}, customer_name = #{customerName}, customer_mobile = #{customerMobile}, customer_source = #{customerSource}, owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}, owner_user_name = #{ownerUserName}, owner_dept_id = #{ownerDeptId}, owner_dept_name = #{ownerDeptName}, operator_user_id = #{operatorUserId}, operator_user_name = #{operatorUserName}, operator_dept_id = #{operatorDeptId}, operator_dept_name = #{operatorDeptName}, biz_trace_id = #{bizTraceId}, source_table_name = #{sourceTableName} where id = #{id} and valid_flag = 0
